empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Import a skill from a file, a URL, or the community catalog.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

community.noRepos: Connect a project to import community skills into it.

unavailable.title: Catalog unavailable
unavailable.fallbackBody: Could not reach the community catalog.

empty.title: Catalog is empty
empty.body: The catalog was reached successfully, but it has no entries yet.

noMatch.title: No matching skills
noMatch.body: Try a different search term or clear the active filter.

listItem.scanFlagged: {count, plural, one {# issue found} other {# issues found}}
listItem.scanFlaggedTitle: Content scan flagged this skill — open it to see what and why

preview.deleteError: Failed to delete skill. Please try again.
preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.scanPendingNotice: Content scan in progress — this skill can't be enabled until it finishes.
preview.scanErrorNotice: Content scan failed and could not confirm this skill is safe. It's treated as unsafe until re-scanned — use "Re-scan" above.
preview.scanFlaggedNotice: Content scan flagged {count, plural, one {# issue} other {# issues}} in this skill's body — reasons below.
preview.enableBlockedHint: Blocked by the content scan — a critical/high finding (or a scan that hasn't completed/failed) must be resolved or re-scanned clean before this skill can be enabled.
preview.enableBlockedError: Could not enable this skill — the content scan blocks it.
preview.enableOverrideConfirm: This skill's content scan found lower-severity issues (not critical/high). Enable it anyway?
preview.descriptionHint: This is the skill's interface — phrase it directively (what the agent should do with it), not as a summary.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.

scope.label: Project
scope.hint: Global skills apply everywhere. Scoping to a project hides it from other projects' filtered lists and deletes it if that project is removed.
scope.reassignError: Could not change this skill's project. Please try again.

previewTab.title: Preview
previewTab.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.

context.title: Context
context.inheritNote: Any agent using this skill inherits these documents.
context.empty: No documents discovered in this repo yet.
context.loadError: Could not load project context documents.
context.dragHandleInertLabel: Reordering is disabled while the filter is active

empty.title: Not used by any agent yet
empty.body: Attach this skill to an agent to start collecting usage stats.

stats.noAgents: No agents currently use this skill.
stats.noFindings: No findings in the last 30 days.

empty.title: No version history
empty.body: Versions are recorded whenever the skill body changes.

versions.restoreConfirm: Restore version {version}? This creates a new version with its body.

trend.title: Trend · last {count, plural, one {# run} other {# runs}}
trend.open: Open this skill's full eval dashboard
trend.empty: No finished runs yet — run the evals to start a trend.

draft.title: Draft results
draft.hint: Unsaved text — these results don't change the metrics above.

reason.scanPending: Content scan hasn't finished — evals can't run until it passes.
reason.scanError: Content scan failed — re-scan this skill before running evals.
reason.scanFlagged: Content scan flagged blocking issues — resolve them before running evals.
reason.running: A run is already in progress.
